name: Cut-out composite
summary: Cut-out photos placed on a flat or photo ground at a chosen odd scale.
how: Cut the subject out with a clean or deliberately rough edge of 1 to 2px.
Place it on a flat colour or a second photo.
Scale it 20% to 400% out of true size.
Add 3% to 8% grain over all layers.

origin.note: Adobe releases Photoshop 1.0, which makes layered cut-outs a desktop task.

adoptions.via: Product cut-outs on white form the cells of the starter pack collage.
Meme makers place cut-outs at odd scale in surreal memes.
